question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Something that can be carried easily
solution:
The correct answer is '**Portable**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Something that can be carried easily is said as Portable**
 
• Some other similar words to '**Portable**' are **handy**, **movable**, and com
